channel.title: GetMacros Nutrition Guides

item.title: Are Diet Drinks Bad for You? | GetMacros
item.description: Are diet drinks bad for you? Separate sweetener safety, weight-control evidence and practical drink choices without treating every can as good or bad.

item.title: Best Fast-Food Restaurants for Your Goals | GetMacros
item.description: Compare fast-food restaurants for high protein, cutting, bulking, fiber and plant-based meals using complete orders and visible nutrition trade-offs.

item.title: Body Recomposition: Build Muscle, Lose Fat
item.description: What body recomposition means, who it actually works for, how to set protein and calories for it, and how long to expect it to take before you judge results.

item.title: Should You Eat the Same Calories on Rest Days? | GetMacros
item.description: You can keep calories the same on rest days or cycle them around training. Compare both approaches while keeping recovery and your weekly goal in view.

item.title: Calories vs. Macros: What Matters More? | GetMacros
item.description: Calories vs. macros: learn which matters for weight change, muscle, fullness and performance—and how to set priorities without tracking everything.

item.title: What Do Carbs Do? Energy, Glycogen and Fiber | GetMacros
item.description: How carbohydrates fuel your body and brain, how glycogen storage works, and what happens on very low-carb diets — with cited sources.

item.title: Healthy CAVA Orders: Bowls, Calories & Protein | GetMacros
item.description: Compare all 4 tracked CAVA items by calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Grilled chicken over greens, light dressing leads on protein at 38 g.

item.title: Healthy Chick-fil-A Options: High-Protein Meals | GetMacros
item.description: Compare all 11 tracked Chick-fil-A items by calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Top protein 104 g; lightest substantial order 130 calories.

item.title: Healthy Chipotle Orders: Calories & Protein | GetMacros
item.description: Compare all 6 tracked Chipotle items by calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Chicken Bowl with white rice and black beans leads on protein at 48 g.

item.title: Cutting vs. Bulking vs. Maintenance
item.description: What the terms cutting, bulking, and maintenance actually mean in terms of calories and macros, and how to tell which one you should be doing.

item.title: Does Creatine Cause Hair Loss? | GetMacros
item.description: Does creatine cause hair loss? See what the 2009 DHT study found, what the 2025 hair-follicle trial added and what remains uncertain.

item.title: Healthy Dunkin' Breakfast: Calories & Protein | GetMacros
item.description: Compare all 4 tracked Dunkin’ items by calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Sourdough Breakfast Sandwich leads on protein at 24 g.

item.title: What Does Fat Do? Hormones, Vitamins and Intake | GetMacros
item.description: What dietary fat does for hormones, cell membranes, and vitamin absorption, how much you need, and the signs of getting too little — with cited sources.

item.title: Healthy Fast Food: Best High-Protein Orders | GetMacros
item.description: Compare 83 fast-food options across 15 chains by calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Find meals for cutting, bulking, high protein and vegetarian goals.

item.title: High-Protein Foods Ranked by Protein Per Calorie
item.description: 25 high-protein foods ranked by protein per 100 g, protein per 100 calories and protein in a realistic serving, so you can compare them the way you eat them.

item.title: How Many Calories Should I Eat a Day? | GetMacros
item.description: Work out your daily calorie target from your body size, activity and goal, see the maths behind it, and learn why the number is an estimate to adjust.

item.title: How Much Fiber Per Day, and Where to Get It | GetMacros
item.description: The daily fiber target, why most people miss it, which foods close the gap fastest, and how to raise your intake without the discomfort that stops people.

item.title: How Much Protein Can Your Body Absorb at Once? | GetMacros
item.description: Your body does not waste protein after 30 grams. Learn the difference between protein absorption, muscle protein synthesis and practical meal distribution.

item.title: How Much Protein Do You Need Per Day?
item.description: How much protein you actually need per day for baseline health, general fitness, and muscle building, based on RDA and sports nutrition research.

item.title: How Much Sodium Per Day? Limits and Real Meals | GetMacros
item.description: The daily sodium limits health authorities set, how much a single restaurant meal can hold, and how to keep your total sensible without tracking milligrams.
